proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + passive_property family
proposed_widenings.justification: No MagicItemRecord exists in UnitRecord. Magic items that are always-on while worn need a new top-level record kind and a new mechanics family distinct from spell/class-feature/mastery activation patterns.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing these dark lenses, you have Darkvision out to 60 feet.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_sense surface type (darkvision with range)
proposed_widenings.justification: The v4 atom inventory lists grant_sense but types.ts has no surface type expressing it. A darkvision grant requires a sense kind (darkvision) and a range in feet.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you have Darkvision out to 60 feet

proposed_widenings.name: conditional sense extension: grant if absent, extend if present
proposed_widenings.justification: The item has two branches: grant 60ft darkvision if the wearer lacks it, or extend existing darkvision by 60ft. This conditional-extension pattern does not map to any existing effect atom or surface shape.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you already have Darkvision, wearing the goggles increases its range by 60 feet.

notes: The blocking gap is structural: UnitRecord has no magic_item kind. Even if MagicItemRecord were added, this specific item requires (a) a passive/worn mechanics family with no activation cost and no use-count resource, and (b) a conditional sense grant/extend effect that the current effect atom set cannot represent. The grant_sense v4 atom exists in the taxonomy but has no surface encoding in types.ts.
